full_judgment:
This appeal arises out of a suit for declaration of title and recovery of khas possession and for mesne profit. Defendants 1-5 contested the suit by filing a written statement in which they denied the material allegations made in the plaint and asserted their own right, title and possession. 

 2. The plaintiff's case was that they acquired the suit lands covering three khatians namely, C. S. Khatian Nos. 55, 71 and 75 by auction purchase and they obtained delivery of possession of the same. The defendants having dispossessed them from C. S. plot No. 747 of C. S. Khatian No. 71, the plaintiffs filed a suit under Section 9 C. P. C. being Title Suit No. 108 of 1958 against the defendants for recovery of the said plot which was however dismissed. Thereafter, in April, 1959 the defendants dispossessed the plaintiffs from the rest of the suit lands. Hence the suit for declaration of title and recovery of khas possession and for mesne profit relating to the lands of the aforesaid three khatians namely C. S. Khatian No. 55, 71 and 75.
